title: Kala Alexis Fierro

scope.target: Universal Codex holography, transformation choreography, control grammar, living ink
not_auto_imported: Kala Alexis Fierro as an ArcSweep character
story events, cosmology, combat outcomes, or setting lore

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: A magical device changes between wearable and weapon states, with staff, bow, sword, defensive, sealing, healing, and air-combat modes.
observed_mechanisms.codex_application: Treat Codex tools as named stateful forms rather than generic panels. A tool invocation can visibly transform one projection grammar into another while preserving a single underlying object identity.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: The user gives short spoken commands and the device confirms, prepares, activates, or rejects state changes.
observed_mechanisms.codex_application: Map voice, tap, Pencil, and gesture actions to explicit command verbs with visible confirmation receipts: invoke, engage, seal, protect, open, bind, project, dismiss.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Wearable objects transform through bright light into gemmed gloves, armour, weapons, stabilisers, barriers, and other functional states.
observed_mechanisms.codex_application: Use staged animation: seed light -> glyph geometry -> projected construction lines -> materialised control/object -> persistent state marker.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: The device speaks, reports state, warns of incoming events, announces failures, and responds conversationally.
observed_mechanisms.codex_application: Projected controls may have a concise machine voice/state-caption layer without replacing the accessible DOM or model-authored conversation surface.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Modes can fail, be damaged, behave imperfectly, or require recovery/merge rather than silently succeeding.
observed_mechanisms.codex_application: Animation must represent degraded/failed states truthfully. No success flourish when the underlying action failed; damaged or unavailable tools can visibly flicker, collapse, or remain incomplete.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Damaged devices can merge/synchronise into a new functional unit after an explicit choice.
observed_mechanisms.codex_application: Use consented merge choreography for combining tools, views, or data layers: preview both sources, show convergence geometry, require explicit adoption, then emit a receipt naming the new composite state.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Protection appears as luminous shields; sealing appears as chains/bindings and converts a dangerous target into a contained artefact.
observed_mechanisms.codex_application: Quarantine, provenance lock, and protected-mode UI can use enclosure/ring/binding animation rather than generic modal dialogs, while preserving exact status text.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: Air-combat mode manifests stabilisers/thrusters and materially changes movement behaviour.
observed_mechanisms.codex_application: Spatial panels can transition between anchored-to-page and free-orbit modes, with visible stabiliser geometry marking the movement contract.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: The device explicitly announces a numbered receipt after a sealing action.
observed_mechanisms.codex_application: ArcSweep receipts can become diegetic objects: each completed transformation/action may leave a numbered luminous receipt glyph that can be opened for the exact machine record.

observed_mechanisms.source_observation: The source repeatedly uses white, metallic gold, jewels, brilliant light, energy arrows, and luminous barriers.
observed_mechanisms.codex_application: Candidate visual family for a transformation/projection profile: white-gold structural light with gem-like nodes, distinct from ArcSweep's normal copper/green binding palette.
